race.comment: WINTERINTHECAPITAL (9) makes most appeal on debut after her latest trial produced a close second at Kembla Grange. The Gary Portelli-trained mare also has a half-sibling who placed on debut over 1000m, which adds some support to the profile. Boudvillain's booking is a big tick and she can debut with a bang. CHUMPAKIDD (1) is the best exposed danger after being beaten just under a length at Orange, where he moved into the race and was only grabbed late. Third-up fitness is in his favour, though his record around 1000m still leaves a small query.  AERIALIZE (11) has race fitness and a genuine excuse after being bumped and racing wide at Orange, so she stays in the mix if she handles the quick back-up. DOUBLE RAINBOW (6) won't be far away coming back in trip.
